titleZh: Burnaby 廚房裝修費用 2026：造價 $20,000 至 $130,000 真实案例
excerptEn: A Burnaby kitchen renovation costs $20,000 to $130,000 in 2026. See the real price breakdown by scope, cabinet type, and countertop material, based on actual Reno Stars project data.
excerptZh: Burnaby 廚房裝修造價範圍由 $20,000 至 $130,000。聚星裝修以真實工程案例為你拆解造價明細。
contentEn:
A complete kitchen renovation in Burnaby in 2026 typically costs between $20,000 and $130,000, depending on cabinet scope, countertop material, whether plumbing or electrical work is involved, and the age of the building. Minor cosmetic updates start around $20,000–$35,000. A mid-range renovation with new cabinets and stone countertops runs $40,000–$75,000. A full custom-cabinet gut renovation with structural changes can reach $90,000–$130,000 or more.

What Drives Kitchen Renovation Cost in Burnaby

Three decisions account for most of the cost difference between a $35,000 and a $100,000 kitchen in Burnaby: the cabinet scope, the countertop selection, and whether the layout changes. Each factor can shift the total by $15,000–$40,000 on its own.

Cabinet Scope: Refacing vs. New Cabinets

Cabinet work is consistently the largest single line item in any Burnaby kitchen renovation, representing 30–45% of the total budget. Cabinet refacing — keeping the existing cabinet boxes and replacing doors, drawer fronts, and hardware — starts at approximately $8,000–$18,000 for a standard Burnaby kitchen. Custom-built new cabinets for the same space typically cost $25,000–$55,000, depending on size, material grade, and finish.

Partial custom cabinets — for example, building a new pantry unit or a TV alcove while refacing the remaining cabinets — typically runs $18,000–$30,000 and is a common choice in Burnaby townhouses where standard dimensions do not fit the space.

Countertop Material: Laminate to Quartz

Countertop material is the second-largest cost driver. Laminate countertops start at approximately $1,200–$3,500 for a standard kitchen. Solid surface (Corian) runs $3,500–$7,000. Quartz — the most popular choice in Reno Stars Burnaby projects — ranges from $4,500 to $12,000 depending on brand, edge profile, and square footage. Natural stone (granite) falls in a similar range to quartz at $5,000–$13,000.

Layout Changes: Moving Plumbing and Electrical

Keeping the sink and stove in their existing locations can save $4,000–$12,000 compared to relocating them, which requires a licensed plumber and electrician and may involve floor and wall reopening. In Burnaby's older high-rise and townhouse developments, some buildings also require specific fixture types or have restriction on water-pressure modifications that add to plumbing costs.

Burnaby Kitchen Renovation Cost by Scope

  • Minor update (new doors, laminate countertop, new faucet, fresh paint): $18,000–$32,000
  • Mid-range renovation (cabinet refacing, quartz countertop, new faucet and sink, tile backsplash): $38,000–$65,000
  • Custom cabinet full renovation (all-new custom cabinets, quartz or granite, layout changes, new electrical): $70,000–$130,000+

Timeline: How Long Does a Burnaby Kitchen Renovation Take

Permit processing in Burnaby takes 3–6 weeks for structural or electrical work. Active construction runs 6–14 weeks depending on scope. A minor update can complete in 3–5 weeks with no permit required. A mid-range renovation typically needs 7–10 weeks from permit approval to handover. A full custom-cabinet renovation with layout changes can take 10–18 weeks.

Reno Stars coordinates with the City of Burnaby building department and arranges required inspections to keep projects on schedule. A dedicated project manager (Jasper) is the daily point of contact for every Burnaby kitchen project.

Planning a kitchen renovation in Burnaby? Get a free, no-obligation estimate from Reno Stars.

What Is Included in a Reno Stars Burnaby Kitchen Quote

Every Reno Stars Burnaby kitchen renovation quote is a fixed-price contract that itemises demolition, framing if required, plumbing, electrical, cabinet supply and installation, countertop templating and installation, tiling, painting, and final cleanup. Materials (tiles, fixtures, lighting, cabinet hardware) are client-selected with contractor support — Reno Stars provides the supplier contact and goes to the showroom with the client to confirm selections. The contract clearly lists the payment schedule before work begins.

Real Burnaby kitchen projects completed by Reno Stars include a townhouse kitchen renovation in Burnaby with custom Wood Vein cabinets and black fixtures, and a Metrotown condo flooring and kitchen refresh. Both projects were completed on schedule and within the contracted budget.

What homeowners in Burnaby consistently request

  • Quartz countertops (consistently the top choice across all Burnaby projects)
  • Pull-out pantry shelves and deep drawers instead of base shelving
  • Under-cabinet LED lighting
  • Matte black or brushed gold faucet and hardware finishes
  • Waterproof vinyl or engineered hardwood flooring in the kitchen

Burnaby Kitchen Renovation Permits

Burnaby requires a building permit for any work that changes the structural configuration of a kitchen, including removing or adding walls, moving plumbing fixtures, or altering electrical circuits. A simple cabinet reface with no changes to plumbing or electrical typically does not require a permit. Reno Stars handles the permit application as part of the project scope — the client does not submit it separately. Permit fees in Burnaby are based on the estimated construction value and are billed at cost.

Finishing Choices That Affect Cost and Value

Three finishing decisions in a Burnaby kitchen renovation have outsized impact on both cost and resale value. First, the cabinet finish: matte lacquer or thermofoil doors in a custom colour cost approximately $2,000–$5,000 more than a standard white thermofoil but significantly improve the finished look. Second, the backsplash: a full-height quartz or porcelain slab backsplash (increasingly popular in Burnaby new developments) adds $2,500–$6,000 over a standard tile backsplash. Third, lighting: roughing in additional pot light locations during renovation (before the ceiling is closed) costs approximately $800–$1,500 per location; doing it after closing costs two to three times as much.

How to Budget for Your Burnaby Kitchen Renovation

Start with a realistic assessment of what you want to change versus what you can keep. If the existing cabinet boxes are structurally sound and the layout works, refacing saves $15,000–$30,000 over custom cabinets and typically completes four to six weeks faster. If the layout does not work for how your household uses the kitchen, investing in a layout change pays off in daily quality of life and in the resale value of the home.

Add 10–15% to your budget for unexpected conditions discovered during demolition — common in Burnaby's high-rise condos built between 1970 and 1995, where original plumbing and electrical may not meet current code. Reno Stars quotes include a contingency allowance that is disclosed upfront.

For a detailed estimate based on your Burnaby home's specifics, contact Reno Stars for a free on-site consultation.

Burnaby Kitchen Renovation FAQs

How much does a kitchen renovation cost in Burnaby in 2026?

A minor cosmetic kitchen update in Burnaby starts around $18,000–$32,000. A mid-range renovation with new cabinet doors, quartz countertops, and updated fixtures typically runs $38,000–$65,000. A full custom-cabinet gut renovation with layout changes commonly reaches $70,000–$130,000 or more. Prices are based on actual 2025–2026 Reno Stars project data in Burnaby and the Greater Vancouver area.

Does Burnaby require a permit for kitchen renovation?

Burnaby requires a building permit when kitchen renovation involves structural changes, moving plumbing fixtures, or altering electrical circuits. Cosmetic updates such as cabinet refacing, replacing a faucet, or installing a new cooktop without electrical changes typically do not require a permit. Reno Stars handles the permit application on behalf of the homeowner as part of the standard project scope.

How long does a kitchen renovation take in Burnaby?

A minor kitchen update in Burnaby takes 3–5 weeks. A mid-range renovation with no structural changes typically completes in 7–10 weeks from permit approval. A full custom-cabinet renovation with layout changes and structural work takes 10–18 weeks including the 3–6 week permit processing time. Reno Stars assigns a dedicated project manager (Jasper) to every Burnaby kitchen project for the duration of the work.

Should I reface or replace my kitchen cabinets in Burnaby?

If the existing cabinet boxes are structurally sound and the layout works for your household, cabinet refacing is the cost-effective choice — it saves $15,000–$30,000 over custom-built cabinets and completes four to six weeks faster. If the cabinet boxes are damaged, the layout does not suit your needs, or you want a significantly different kitchen configuration, full custom cabinets are the better long-term investment.

What countertop is best for a Burnaby kitchen renovation?

Quartz is the most popular countertop choice across Reno Stars Burnaby kitchen projects. It offers high durability, resistance to staining and scratching, and comes in a wide range of colours that complement both modern and traditional kitchen styles. Laminate is a practical budget option; solid surface and granite are mid-range to premium alternatives. Reno Stars provides supplier contacts and showroom support for all countertop material choices.
contentZh:
Burnaby 廚房裝修在 2026 年的費用約為 $20,000 至 $130,000，視乎廚房範圍、櫃枱物料及水電改動而定。輕微翻新由約 $20,000 起；中檔裝修連新櫃及石英石檯面約 $40,000–$75,000；全屋訂造櫃枱並改動間隔則可達 $90,000–$130,000 或以上。

影響 Burnaby 廚房裝修費用的主要因素

三個決定構成 Burnaby 廚房裝修費用差距的主要原因：櫃枱工程範圍、檯面物料選擇、以及是否需要改動間隔。每一項因素可將總費用改變 $15,000 至 $40,000 不等。

櫃枱工程：翻新 vs 全新訂造

櫃枱工程是每個廚房裝修項目中最大的單一費用項目，佔總預算 30%–45%。櫃門翻新（即保留現有櫃箱只更換門板及拉手）在標準 Burnaby 廚房約 $8,000–$18,000。同期全屋訂造新櫃約 $25,000–$55,000，視乎尺寸、物料等級及飾面而定。

部分訂造櫃枱（如訂造一個新 pantry 櫃或電視凹位，同時翻新其餘現有櫃門）一般為 $18,000–$30,000，在 Burnaby 鎮屋（townhouse）中相當普遍，因為標準尺寸往往無法配合實際空間。

檯面物料：從層壓板到石英石

檯面物料是第二大費用因素。層壓板（Laminate）檯面由約 $1,200–$3,500 起。人造石（Corian）約 $3,500–$7,000。石英石（Quartz）—— Reno Stars Burnaby 工程中最受歡迎的選擇 —— 根據品牌、邊緣造型及面積，價格由 $4,500 至 $12,000 不等。天然石（花崗岩）造價與石英石相若，約 $5,000–$13,000。

間隔改動：搬位水電工程

保持洗手盤及煮食爐位置不變，最多可節省 $4,000–$12,000（搬位需要持牌水喉匠及電工，並可能涉及打開牆身及地板）。在 Burnaby 的舊式高層大廈及鎮屋小區，部分樓宇對衛生設備类型或水壓改動有特定限制，亦會增加水喉工程費用。

Burnaby 廚房裝修費用：按工程範圍

  • 輕微翻新（更換櫃門、層壓板檯面、龍頭、重新髹油）：$18,000–$32,000
  • 中檔裝修（翻新櫃門、石英石檯面、新龍頭及洗手盤、瓷磚擋板）：$38,000–$65,000
  • 全屋訂造櫃枱翻新（全新訂造櫃、石英石或花崗岩檯面、間隔改動、新 electrical）：$70,000–$130,000+

施工時間：Burnaby 廚房裝修需時多久

Burnaby 的許可證審批時間為 3–6 星期（涉及結構或電工工程）。實際施工時間視乎工程範圍，由 6 至 14 星期不等。輕微翻新一般 3–5 星期完成，無需申請許可證。中檔裝修一般由許可證批出至交樓需時 7–10 星期。全屋訂造櫃枱並涉及間隔改動的工程，則需 10–18 星期。

聚星裝修（Reno Stars）協調 Burnaby 市府建築部門安排所需檢驗，確保工程按進度完成。每個 Burnaby 廚房工程均指派專屬項目統籌（Jasper）為日常聯絡窗口。

正在規劃 Burnaby 廚房裝修？立即聯絡聚星裝修取得免費估算。

聚星裝修 Burnaby 廚房報價包含什麼

每份聚星裝修 Burnaby 廚房報價均為定價合約，清楚列出：清拆、主體結構（如有需要）、水喉、電工、訂造櫃枱供應及安裝、檯面模板及安裝、瓷磚、髹油及最終清潔。物料（瓷磚、衛生設備、燈具、櫃門拉手）由客戶在承辦商支援下自行挑選 — 聚星裝修提供供應商聯絡並陪同客戶到陳列室確認選擇。工程合約於開工前清楚列明付款時間表。

聚星裝修完成的真實 Burnaby 廚房工程包括：Burnaby 鎮屋訂造木紋廚房櫃配黑色五金工程，以及 Metrotown 公寓地板及廚房翻新工程。兩個項目均按時完成並在合約預算內交付。

Burnaby 業主常見要求

  • 石英石檯面（所有聚星裝修 Burnaby 工程中最普遍的選擇）
  • 拉出式 pantry 架子及深抽屜取代底層架子
  • 櫃底 LED 照明
  • 啞光黑或拉絲金屬水龍頭及五金
  • 廚房防水乙烯基或工程木地板

Burnaby 廚房裝修許可證

Burnaby 要求就任何涉及更改廚房結構配置（包括拆除或增加牆壁、移動衛生設備或更改電路）的工程申請建築許可證。一般無需改動間隔或水電的櫃門翻新工程，則通常不需要許可證。聚星裝修代表業主提交許可證申請，作為標準工程範圍的一部分。Burnaby 的許可證費用按工程估算價值計算，按成本收取。

影響費用及價值的裝修選擇

三個收尾選擇對 Burnaby 廚房裝修的費用及轉售價值均有重大影響。其一，櫃門飾面：啞光漆或焗漆門（按訂造顏色）比標準白色焗漆貴約 $2,000–$5,000，但完工效果顯著提升。其二，擋板：全高石英石或瓷板擋板（在 Burnaby 新發展項目中越來越受歡迎）比標準瓷磚擋板貴 $2,500–$6,000。其三，照明：在吊頂封板前預留額外筒燈位置（約 $800–$1,500/位置）；封板後再加則需兩至三倍費用。

如何預算您的 Burnaby 廚房裝修

先就您想改動及可保留的部分作務實評估。若現有櫃箱結構完好且間隔適用，翻新櫃門比訂造新櫃節省 $15,000–$30,000，並通常快四至六星期完工。若間隔不適合您的生活方式，或您希望廚房配置有明顯改動，投資於間隔改動在日常生活質素及房屋轉售價值方面均更划算。

在預算中加入 10%–15% 以應對清拆時發現的意外情況 — 這在 1970 至 1995 年間建造的 Burnaby 高層大廈及鎮屋中相當普遍，原有水喉及電工可能不符合現行規範。聚星裝修的報價已預先披露應急費用部分。

欲根據您的 Burnaby 單位具體情況獲取詳細估算，請聯絡聚星裝修安排免費上門估價。

Burnaby 廚房裝修常見問題

2026 年 Burnaby 廚房裝修要多少錢？

Burnaby 輕微廚房翻新由約 $18,000–$32,000 起。中檔裝修更換櫃門、石英石檯面及更新設備，一般為 $38,000–$65,000。全屋訂造櫃枱並改動間隔的全面翻新，通常為 $70,000–$130,000 或以上。價格根據 2025–2026 年聚星裝修 Burnaby 及大溫哥華地區實際工程數據制定。

Burnaby 廚房裝修需要許可證嗎？

Burnaby 要求就涉及結構改動、移動衛生設備或更改電路的廚房工程申請建築許可證。更換櫃門、安裝新龍頭或在不更改電路的情況下更換煮食爐等輕微翻新工程，通常不需要許可證。聚星裝修代表業主提交許可證申請作為標準工程範圍的一部分。

Burnaby 廚房裝修需要多久？

Burnaby 輕微廚房翻新需時 3–5 星期。中檔裝修無需結構改動者，一般由許可證批出至交付需時 7–10 星期。全屋訂造櫃枱並有結構改動的工程，由許可證審批（3–6 星期）至完工需 10–18 星期。聚星裝修為每個 Burnaby 廚房工程指派專屬項目統籌（Jasper）負責全程跟進。

我應該翻新還是更換 Burnaby 的櫃枱？

若現有櫃箱結構完好且間隔適合您的使用需求，翻新櫃門是最省錢的選擇 — 比訂造新櫃節省 $15,000–$30,000，並通常快四至六星期完工。若櫃箱已損壞、間隔不適用，或您希望廚房配置有明顯改動，全面訂造櫃枱是更值得的長期投資。

Burnaby 廚房裝修用哪種檯面最好？

石英石是聚星裝修所有 Burnaby 廚房工程中最受歡迎的檯面選擇。石英石耐用度高、抗污耐刮，顏色選擇多樣，可配合現代及傳統風格。層壓板是實惠之選；人造石及花崗岩則屬中高檔替代方案。聚星裝修為所有檯面物料選擇提供供應商聯絡及陳列室支援。
